about: Real OpenLLMetry (traceloop-sdk) spans from its OpenAI and Anthropic instrumentors and its decorators, recorded against mocked providers through an httpx/httpx2 mock transport: no network, no API keys, no rius SDK. Three releases, chosen for what changed between them (see each note). Moved here from argus-core's sink testdata, where Kiran first recorded them; the scenarios and responses are unchanged. Only the sink normalizes this family, so the expected result is the row the sink stores.
record: python record.py <recording.json> <environment.json>, in a virtualenv holding exactly the pins below
other_bundled_instrumentors: traceloop-sdk does not pin its other bundled instrumentors, so the resolver installed newer ones; none of them is exercised here.

openllmetry-0.47.5.json.note: The last release whose usage keys are gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens / completion_tokens (0.48.0 moved to input_tokens / output_tokens). Needs the OTel SDK of its time: opentelemetry-api/sdk 1.38.0, since 1.44 removed the opentelemetry._events module it imports. The venv pinned opentelemetry-api, -sdk, -proto and the otlp exporters at 1.38.0 and opentelemetry-instrumentation / -semantic-conventions at 0.59b0.

scenarios.openai_chat: OpenAI chat completion with a system and a user message.
scenarios.openai_chat_stream: Streaming OpenAI chat completion with usage on the final chunk.
scenarios.openai_tool_call: OpenAI chat completion offering a tool; the response is a tool call.
scenarios.openai_tool_response: The follow-up: the tool call and its result in the input, a text answer out.
scenarios.anthropic_chat: Anthropic message with a system prompt.
scenarios.anthropic_tool_call: Anthropic message offering a tool; the response is a tool_use block.
scenarios.anthropic_tool_response: The follow-up: tool_use and tool_result in the input, a text answer out.
scenarios.anthropic_error: Anthropic answers 400. Before 0.54.0 the instrumentor re-raises without ending its span, so the scenario exports no span.
scenarios.traceloop_decorators: traceloop's @workflow/@agent/@task/@tool decorators around one OpenAI call: the span-kind taxonomy.

openllmetry-0.47.5.json.verified: Re-recorded 2026-10-12 twice in a row in the pinned virtualenv: byte-identical. Content (names, attributes, events, status) matches the recordings first made in argus-core's sink testdata; only the ids and times, now kept, and the order of event attributes, now sorted, differ.

openllmetry-0.53.4.json.note: The last release in which BOTH provider instrumentors write the flattened gen_ai.prompt.N.* / gen_ai.completion.N.* messages. anthropic moved to gen_ai.input.messages in 0.54.0, openai in 0.55.0.
